data.exact_reserve_text: Unfavourable prior year loss development of GBP 7.3 million was recorded in 2020 compared to unfavourable development of GBP 5.5 million in the prior calendar year. In the current calendar year, the unfavourable loss development was driven primarily by higher emergence of claims of certain lines business than previously anticipated.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an unfavourable prior year loss development of GBP 7.3m in 2020 (gross), driven predominantly by adverse emergence of claims in certain lines of business. The overall calendar year deterioration was also influenced by losses related to the COVID-19 pandemic. The prior year movement represents a net strengthening of reserves compared to the opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: Unfavourable prior year loss development of GBP 7.3 million was recorded in 2020 compared to unfavourable development of GBP 5.5 million in the prior calendar year.
the unfavourable loss development was driven primarily by higher emergence of claims of certain lines business than previously anticipated.
the impact of losses related to the COVID-19 pandemic.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development extracted from Note 5 ('Claims incurred' / 'Over/(under) provisions...') which explicitly states 'Unfavourable prior year loss development of GBP 7.3 million...' (taken as gross). There is some ambiguity in the sign/parenthesis convention in the tabular lines; the narrative clarifies direction. A claims development triangle (gross) is present in the report (pages 45-46) but parsing of the triangle rows programmatically was uncertain in this extraction, so the triangle rows are not fully reproduced here. Mapping of the small split by 'Commercial' and 'Specialty' to standard Lloyd's LOBs is judgmental and low confidence; these mappings are provided as best-effort.
